```{r}
pdx11 <- Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/QC/*_summary.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, select = "mean_qscore_template") %>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_summary.tsv", "", basename(.x)))) 

nanopore_len <- Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/QC/*_summary.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, select = "sequence_length_template") %>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_summary.tsv", "", basename(.x)))) 


# subset for testing 
pdx11_sub <- pdx11 %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  sample_n(1000) %>%
  ungroup()

qscore_sub <- pdx11_sub %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "Xenograft")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = mean_qscore_template, sample, fill = sample_type))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
       strip.text.x = element_blank())+
  ylab("Mean Base Quality Score")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette)


# subset for testing 
library(ggridges)
nanopore_len_sub <- nanopore_len%>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  sample_n(1000) %>%
  ungroup()



# actual plotting 
len_plot <- nanopore_len %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "Xenograft")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sequence_length_template, y = sample, fill = sample_type))+
  stat_density_ridges(stat = "density")+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_y", strip.position = "right", nrow = 2)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none",
       strip.text.y = element_blank())+
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette)+
  xlab("Read Length (bp)")



qscore <- pdx11 %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "Xenograft")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = mean_qscore_template, sample, fill = sample_type))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       strip.text.x = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none")+
  ylab("Mean Base Quality Score")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette)
```

# QC plots

```{r}
coverage <- Sys.glob("output/*/coverage/*mosdepth.summary.txt")%>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x)%>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_unphased.mosdepth.summary.txt", "", basename(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, level = paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom))


coverage_plot <-coverage %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(coverage = round(sum(mean *bases / sum(bases)), 0)) %>%
  ungroup()  %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "Xenograft")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = coverage, fill = sample_type))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom")+
  theme_bw()+
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0(coverage, "x")), vjust=0)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       strip.text.x = element_blank(),
       axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none",
       axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  ylab("Averaged Depth")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette, "Sample")
  

merged_plot <- ggarrange(len_plot,ggarrange(coverage_plot+
            theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.title.x = element_blank()), qscore, nrow = 2, heights = c(0.3, 0.7), align= "v"), common.legend = T, legend = "bottom")
ggsave(plot = merged_plot, filename = "plots/nanopore_qc.pdf",  width = 210, height = 297, units = "mm")
```

## island collapsed

```{r}
island_meth <- Sys.glob("output/*/Me/*pileup_island_tab.bed") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, select = c(1,2,3,4,5,11),col.names = c("chrom", "start", "end", "mod_type", "Nvalid_cov", "fraction_mod"), nThread = 4) %>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_pileup_island_tab.bed", "", basename(.x)))) 


ucsc_island_annot <- fread("ref/cpg_islands_ucsc.bed") %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, chromStart,chromEnd, name) %>%
  mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, levels = paste0("chr", seq(0, 22)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom))%>%
  mutate(chromStart_ext = chromStart-4000,
         chromEnd_ext = chromEnd+4000,
         island_bin_size = (chromEnd-chromStart)/10)



island_5mc <- island_meth %>%
  filter(mod_type == "m")


island_collapsed <- island_5mc %>%
  inner_join(ucsc_island_annot, by = join_by(chrom == chrom, start >= chromStart_ext, start <= chromEnd_ext)) %>%
  mutate(bin = case_when(start < chromStart ~ floor((start- chromStart+4000)/200),
                         start >=chromStart & start <chromEnd ~ floor((start-chromStart)/island_bin_size)+20,
                         start >= chromEnd ~ floor((start -chromEnd)/200) + 30)) %>%
  group_by(bin, sample) %>%
  summarise(mean_beta = mean(fraction_mod)) %>%
  ungroup() 


plot_list <- island_collapsed %>%
  mutate(HRD = case_when(sample %in% hom_me_list ~"hom_meBRCA1",
                         sample %in% het_me_list ~"het_meBRCA1",
                         sample == "UWB1" ~"mut_BRCA1",
                          sample == "UWB1_BRCA1" ~"func_BRCA1",),
         HRD = factor(HRD, levels = c("mut_BRCA1","hom_meBRCA1",  "het_meBRCA1", "func_BRCA1"))) %>%
  group_by(HRD) %>%
  group_map(~ggplot(.x ,aes(x = bin, y = mean_beta, color = sample, group = sample)) +
  geom_line()+
  theme_bw()+
    ylim(c(0,100))+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  guides(col = guide_legend(nrow = 2))+
  facet_wrap(~HRD), .keep =T)

ggarrange(plotlist = plot_list)



island_5hmc <- island_meth %>%
  filter(mod_type == "h")


island_collapsed <- island_5hmc %>%
  inner_join(ucsc_island_annot, by = join_by(chrom == chrom, start >= chromStart_ext, start <= chromEnd_ext)) %>%
  mutate(bin = case_when(start < chromStart ~ floor((start- chromStart+4000)/200),
                         start >=chromStart & start <chromEnd ~ floor((start-chromStart)/island_bin_size)+20,
                         start >= chromEnd ~ floor((start -chromEnd)/200) + 30)) %>%
  group_by(bin, sample) %>%
  summarise(mean_beta = mean(fraction_mod)) %>%
  ungroup() 


plot_list <- island_collapsed %>%
  mutate(HRD = case_when(sample %in% hom_me_list ~"hom_meBRCA1",
                         sample %in% het_me_list ~"het_meBRCA1",
                         sample == "UWB1" ~"mut_BRCA1",
                          sample == "UWB1_BRCA1" ~"func_BRCA1",),
         HRD = factor(HRD, levels = c("mut_BRCA1","hom_meBRCA1",  "het_meBRCA1", "func_BRCA1"))) %>%
  group_by(HRD) %>%
  group_map(~ggplot(.x ,aes(x = bin, y = mean_beta, color = sample, group = sample)) +
  geom_line()+
  theme_bw()+
    ylim(c(0,5))+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  guides(col = guide_legend(nrow = 2))+
  facet_wrap(~HRD), .keep =T)
  
ggarrange(plotlist = plot_list)

```

```{r}
brca1 <- Sys.glob("output/*/Me/*_brca1_mod.summary")%>%

  mutate(Meth = if_else(mod_qual >0.5, "Me", "Un"),
```

```{r}
brca1_reads <- brca1 %>%
```

## collapsed furthest - line

```{r}

brca1_collapse <- brca1 %>%
 mutate(Meth = if_else(mod_qual >0.5, "Me", "Un"),
         HRD = case_when(sample %in% hom_me_list ~"HOM_me",
                         sample %in% het_me_list ~"HET_me",
                         sample %in% mut_list ~"MUT",),
         HRD = factor(HRD, levels = c("HOM_me", "HET_me", "MUT"))) %>%
    filter(base_qual >20, !inferred, ref_position>0) %>%
  group_by(read_id, sample, HRD) %>%
  filter(sum(ref_position <= 43125457 & ref_position >=43125336)>2 ) %>%
  mutate(brca1_cov_num = sum(ref_position <= 43125457& ref_position >=43125336),
    read_meth = if_else(sum(ref_position <= 43125457& ref_position >=43125336 & Meth == "Me")> 0.5* brca1_cov_num, "Me", "Un"),
    read_meth = factor(read_meth, levels = c("Me", "Un"))) %>%
  ungroup()  %>%
  group_by(ref_position, read_meth, sample, HRD) %>%
  filter(n()>=2) %>%
  summarise(collapsed_meth = sum(Meth == "Me")/n()) %>%
  ungroup() 

window_filter <- hanning(19)/sum(hanning(19))
plotlist <- brca1_collapse %>%
  group_by(sample, HRD, read_meth) %>%
```

```{r}
OVCAR8 <- fread("output/modkit_dmr/OVCAR8_segments.bed") %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("chrom", "start", "end", "state_name", "score", "N_sites", "sample_a_count", 
                 "sample_b_count", "sample_a_percent", "sample_b_percent", "sample_a_fract_mod", "sample_b_fract_mod", "effect_size"))%>%
  mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, levels = paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom))%>%
  mutate(pair = "OVCAR8")

UWB1 <- fread("output/modkit_dmr/UWB1_segments.bed") %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("chrom", "start", "end", "state_name", "score", "N_sites", "sample_a_count", 
                 "sample_b_count", "sample_a_percent", "sample_b_percent", "sample_a_fract_mod", "sample_b_fract_mod", "effect_size")) %>%
  mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, levels = paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom)) %>%
  mutate(pair = "UWB1")

rbind(UWB1, OVCAR8) %>%
  filter(N_sites > 10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = score, y = N_sites, color = pair))+
  geom_point()+
  xlim(c(0, 10000))+

overlaped_dmr <- UWB1%>%
  filter(state_name== "different", N_sites >=5) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, start_UWB1 = start, end_UWB1 = end, N_sites_UWB1 = N_sites, effect_size_UWB1 = effect_size) %>%
  full_join(OVCAR8 %>%
  filter(state_name== "different", N_sites >=5) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, start_OVCAR8 = start, end_OVCAR8 = end, N_sites_OVCAR8 = N_sites, effect_size_OVCAR8 = effect_size),
  by = join_by("chrom" == "chrom", "start_UWB1" <= "end_OVCAR8", "end_UWB1" >= "start_OVCAR8")) %>%
  mutate(rownum = row_number())

cmd <- overlaped_dmr%>%
  filter(!is.na(start_UWB1), !is.na(start_OVCAR8), effect_size_OVCAR8*effect_size_UWB1 >0,
         abs(effect_size_OVCAR8) >=0.2, abs(effect_size_UWB1) >=0.2) %>%
  mutate(start = pmin(start_UWB1, start_OVCAR8), end = pmax(end_UWB1, end_OVCAR8),
         cmd = paste0("for i in 134011_1910_T4 134048_7794_T2 134062_9174_T4 134169_6606_T2 OVCAR8 OVCAR8_LP_A6_30 SFRC01428S1_22235_T2 SFRC01495S2_1537_T1 SFRC01585S1_2163_T3 SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2 UWB1 UWB1_BRCA1 WEHI_CS62; do ~/local/modkit_v0.3.1/modkit extract -t 12 --region ", chrom, ":", start,"-", end, " ${i}/${i}_mapped.bam ${i}/Me/${i}_",chrom,"_", start,"_",end, "_mod.summary;done")) %>%
  pull(cmd)

write_lines("#!/bin/bash", "scripts/overlapped_dmr.sh")
write_lines(cmd,"scripts/overlapped_dmr.sh",append = T)
library(VennDiagram)
venn.diagram(list(UWB1 = overlaped_dmr %>%filter(!is.na(start_UWB1)) %>% pull(rownum),
```

```{r}
C_pileup <-Sys.glob("output/*/Me/*_m_pileup_tab.bed") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(cmd = paste0("awk '$4 == \"m\" {print $0}' ", .x)) %>%
             `colnames<-`(c("chrom", "start", "end", "mod_type", "Nvalid_cov_2", "strand", "start_2", "end_2", "color_2", "Nvalid_cov", "fraction_mod", "Nmod", "Ncanonical", "Nother_mod", "Ndelete", "Nfail", "Ndiff", "Nnocall")) %>%
             dplyr::select(-contains("_2")) %>%
             mutate(Sample = gsub("_pileup_tab.bed", "", basename(.x))))  %>%
  mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, level = paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom))

bs_matrix <- C_pileup %>%
  dplyr::select("chrom", "start", "end","Sample", "Nvalid_cov", "Nmod") %>%
  dt_pivot_longer(cols = c(Nvalid_cov, Nmod), names_to = "type", values_to = "count") %>%
  dt_pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = count) %>%
  drop_na()


library(bsseq)
library(DMRcate)
library(edgeR)
BS_raw <- BSseq(M =as.matrix(bs_matrix%>%
                      filter(type == "Nmod") %>%
                      dplyr::select(-c(chrom, start, end, type, UWB1_BRCA1_m, UWB1_m, WEHI_CS62_m, OVCAR8_LP_A6_30_m, OVCAR8_m, `134048_7794_T2_m`))),
                Cov=as.matrix(bs_matrix%>%
                      filter(type == "Nvalid_cov") %>%
                      dplyr::select(-c(chrom, start, end, type, UWB1_BRCA1_m, UWB1_m, WEHI_CS62_m, OVCAR8_LP_A6_30_m,OVCAR8_m, `134048_7794_T2_m`))),
                    sampleNames = c("134011_1910_T4_m","134062_9174_T4_m","134169_6606_T2_m","SFRC01428S1_22235_T2_m","SFRC01495S2_1537_T1_m","SFRC01585S1_2163_T3_m","SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2_m"),
                pos =bs_matrix%>%
                      filter(type == "Nvalid_cov") %>%
                      pull(start),
                chr = bs_matrix%>%
                      filter(type == "Nvalid_cov") %>%
                      pull(chrom),
                pData = data.frame(HR = c("HRD", "HRD", "HRP", "HRP", "HRP","HRD", "HRP"),
                                   Me = c("HOM","HOM","HET","HET","HET","HOM","HET"), row.names = c("134011_1910_T4_m","134062_9174_T4_m","134169_6606_T2_m","SFRC01428S1_22235_T2_m","SFRC01495S2_1537_T1_m","SFRC01585S1_2163_T3_m","SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2_m")))

HR <- factor(pData(BS_raw)$HR)
HR <- relevel(HR,ref = "HRP")
design <- model.matrix(~HR)
colnames(design) <- c("Intercept", "HR")
rownames(design) <- colnames(BS_raw )
methdesign <- edgeR::modelMatrixMeth(design)


seq_annot <- sequencing.annotate(BS_raw, methdesign, all.cov = TRUE, fdr=0.5, coef = "HR")

saveRDS(seq_annot, "seq_annot_dmr.RDS")
dmrcate.res <- dmrcate(seq_annot, C=2, min.cpgs = 5)
```

```{r}
sample_annotation <- data.frame(HR = c("HRD", "HRP", "HRD", "HRP", "HRD", "HRP","HRP","HRP","HRD", "HRP", "HRP", "HRD", "HRD"),
                                   Me = c("HOM", "HET","HOM","HET","HOM","HET","HET","HET","HOM","HET", "MUT", "MUT", "HOM"), Sample = c("134011_1910_T4_m","134048_7794_T2_m","134062_9174_T4_m","134169_6606_T2_m","OVCAR8_LP_A6_30_m","OVCAR8_m","SFRC01428S1_22235_T2_m","SFRC01495S2_1537_T1_m","SFRC01585S1_2163_T3_m","SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2_m","UWB1_BRCA1_m", "UWB1_m", "WEHI_CS62_m")) 
island<- fread("ref/cpg_islands_ucsc_cleaned.bed") %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("chr", "i_start", "i_end", "name"))

island_C <- C_pileup %>%
  dplyr::select(chr = chrom, start, end, Sample, Nvalid_cov, fraction_mod) %>%
  right_join(island, by = join_by(chr== chr, start >= i_start, end <= i_end))

island_avg <- island_C %>%
  group_by(chr, i_start, i_end, Sample) %>%
  summarise(avg_meth = mean(fraction_mod)) %>%
  right_join(sample_annotation)

island_avg %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_m", "", Sample)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = avg_meth, x = Sample, color = Me))+
  geom_violin()+
  stat_summary(fun = "median",
               geom = "crossbar", 
               color = "black",
               width = 0.1)+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~Me, scales = "free_x")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))


island_stat <- island_C %>%
  right_join(sample_annotation)%>%
  group_by(chr,i_start,i_end) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_m", "", Sample)) %>%
  filter(Me != "MUT") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  compare_means(data = ., formula = fraction_mod~Me, group.by = c("chr", "i_start","i_end"))

write.table(island_stat, "plots/HOM_HET_ISLAND_wilcox.tsv", quote = F, row.names = F)


island_C_matrix <-island_avg %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(site = paste(chr, i_start, i_end, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select (site, avg_meth, Sample) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = site, values_from = avg_meth)%>%
    column_to_rownames("Sample") 
    
island_C_matrix <- island_C_matrix[,colSums(is.na(island_C_matrix))==0]

library(ggfortify)
```

```{r}
het = c("AOCS-158", "AOCS-057")
hom = c("AOCS-094", "AOCS-125", "AOCS-001", "AOCS-107", "AOCS-164", "AOCS-144", "AOCS-093")

vcf_icgc <-fread("/working/genomeinfo/share/analysis/AOCS_-_ICGC_ovarian_cancer_project/AOCS_-_ICGC_ovarian_cancer_project.StudyPairedAnalysis_20220407.tsv", select = c("testDonorSubmittedWithID", "vcfCompare"),na.strings = c(""), fill= T)  %>%
  mutate(germline =  paste0(vcfCompare, "/",basename(vcfCompare),".Germline.HighConfidence.vcf"),
         somatic = paste0(vcfCompare, "/",basename(vcfCompare),".Somatic.HighConfidence.vcf"),
         germline = if_else(file.exists(germline), germline, NA),
         somatic = if_else(file.exists(somatic), germline, NA))

germline_icgc <-vcf_icgc %>%
  group_by(testDonorSubmittedWithID) %>%
  group_map(~ fread(cmd = paste0("awk '$1==\"chr17\" && $2>=41274353 && $2 <= 41280474 { print $0}' ", .x$germline), sep = "\t", header =F)%>%
            mutate(caseID = unique(.x$testDonorSubmittedWithID)) , .keep = T)

germline_icgc <- bind_rows(germline_icgc)

somatic_icgc <-vcf_icgc %>%
  group_by(testDonorSubmittedWithID) %>%
  group_map(~ fread(cmd = paste0("awk '$1==\"chr17\" && $2>=41274353 && $2 <= 41280474 { print $0}' ", .x$somatic), sep = "\t", header =F)%>%
            mutate(caseID = unique(.x$testDonorSubmittedWithID)) , .keep = T)


somatic_icgc <- bind_rows(somatic_icgc)


vcf_icgc_df <- vcf_icgc %>%
  dplyr::select(caseID =testDonorSubmittedWithID ) %>%
  distinct( )%>%

  mutate(meBRCA1 = case_when(caseID %in% het ~ "HET",
                             caseID %in% hom ~ "HOM",
                             TRUE  ~ "No")) %>%
  left_join(rbind(germline_icgc %>%
              dplyr::select(caseID, chrom = V1, start = V2, SNP = V3, ALT= V5) %>%
              mutate(type = "Germline"),
            somatic_icgc%>%
              dplyr::select(caseID, chrom = V1, start = V2, SNP = V3, ALT= V5)%>%
              mutate(type = "Somatic")))

vcf_icgc_df <- fread("ref/icgc_mut.csv")
vcf_icgc_df %>%

  ggplot(aes(x = start, y = caseID, shape = type, color = ALT))+
  geom_point()+
  facet_wrap(~meBRCA1, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y")

write.table(vcf_icgc_df, "ref/icgc_mut.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

```{r}
OVCAR8_seg <- fread("output/modkit_dmr/OVCAR8_segments.bed") %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("chrom", "start", "end", "state_name", "score", "N_sites", "sample_a_count", 
                 "sample_b_count", "sample_a_percent", "sample_b_percent", "sample_a_fract_mod", "sample_b_fract_mod", "effect_size")) %>%
  filter(N_sites >=5)
OVCAR8_CN <- fread("output/OVCAR8/CNV/OVCAR8_delly_cnv_out.cov.gz")  %>%
  mutate(CN_round = round(OVCAR8_mapped_CN,0))
cn_me <- OVCAR8_CN %>%
  left_join(C_pileup %>%
              filter(Sample == "OVCAR8_m") %>%
              dplyr::select(chr = chrom, me_start = start, me_end =end , Nvalid_cov, fraction_mod), by =join_by(chr== chr, start<= me_start, end >= me_end) ) %>%
  filter(Nvalid_cov >=20, chr == "chr1") %>%
  group_by(chr, start, end, CN_round) %>%
  filter(Nvalid_cov>= OVCAR8_mapped_counts*0.8)


cn_me %>%
  summarise(avg_mod = median(fraction_mod)) %>%
  ungroup( )%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CN_round, y = avg_mod, group = CN_round))+
  geom_violin()+
  stat_summary(fun = "median",
               geom = "crossbar", 
               color = "black",
               width = 0.1)
```

```{r}
match_id_169 <-unlist(as.list(gsub("match: ", "", t(fread("output/134169_6606_T2/134169_6606_T2_LTR_readID.txt", skip = "match", nrow =1, header =F)))))
alt_pos <- unlist(as.list( t(fread("output/134169_6606_T2/134169_6606_T2_LTR_readID.txt", skip = "chr", nrow =1, header =F))))

meth_exr_169_reads_mapping <- meth_extr_169 %>%
  filter(ref_position != -1) %>%
  group_by(read_id) %>%
  summarise(read_start = min(ref_position)- min(forward_read_position))

meth_extr_169 %>% 
  filter(mod_code =="m") %>%
  mutate(alt = case_when(read_id %in% insert_id_169 ~ "INS",
                         read_id %in% match_id_169 ~ "REF",
                         TRUE ~ "NA")) %>%
  left_join(meth_exr_169_reads_mapping)%>%
  mutate(read_relative_position = read_start + forward_read_position ,
         Meth = if_else(mod_qual >0.5, "Me", "Un"),
         Meth = factor(Meth, levels = c("Me", "Un"))) %>%
  filter(read_relative_position >43120000, read_relative_position < 43130000) %>%
  filter(ref_position!= -1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y= read_id, x = ref_position, color = Meth))+
  annotate("rect",xmin=43125336,xmax=43125457,ymin=-Inf,ymax=Inf,alpha=0.1,fill="black")+
```
